interface.title: SWEETer-Cat
interface.field: Astronomy: exoplanet host stars and stellar parameters
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and selecting data from a curated catalogue
interface.what_it_is_for: A web front end to the SWEET-Cat catalogue of host-star parameters (Teff, logg, [Fe/H], mass and more). You can search and sort the table, open a page for each star with its planets, plot stellar and planetary parameters against each other, and download the catalogue.

data.note: The SWEET-Cat table has 3,198 stars and is joined with exoplanet.eu planet data for /plot-exo/ and the star pages. Nothing was uploaded. Downloaded: sweet-cat.csv (655 KB), sweet-cat.tsv, sweet-cat.hdf (4.2 MB, binary), exoplanetEU.csv and bokeh_plot.png. sweetcat.py opened as text in the tab.

features.name: Searchable, sortable catalogue table with column tooltips
features.general: Filter a large table with one free-text box across all columns, sort on any column in either direction, and hover a header to read what the column means and its units
features.specific: DataTables star table: Search box (matches star names and author names), click a header to toggle ascending/descending (opens sorted by Updated, newest first), header tooltips such as 'Effective temperature [K]', star names link to detail pages
steps: Type a name or author in Search
Read the 'filtered from 3,198 entries' count
Click a column header to sort; click again to reverse
Hover a header for its description
Click a star name to open its detail page
serves_tasks: See the newest catalogue entries first
Narrow the table to one source and rank it by a property
Read one object's measured parameters and its companions

features.name: Form-driven scatter plot with optional colour axis, scales and limits
features.general: Choose two variables for the axes and an optional third as a colour scale, set linear or log scales, axis limits and a quality filter, then redraw. A point count in the title shows how many objects are drawn
features.specific: /plot/ and /plot-exo/ settings form: x, y, z dropdowns (z=None gives one fixed Color), x/y scale, Colorscheme (Viridis/Inferno/Plasma), xmin/xmax/ymin/ymax, Homogeneous parameters checkbox, Submit. If x or y was changed, Submit resets that axis's limits to the variable's data range
steps: Pick x and y variables
Optionally pick z for colour, or None plus a fixed colour
Choose linear or log for each axis and a colour scheme
Type axis limits and/or tick Homogeneous parameters
Press Submit and read 'Number of objects in plot'
serves_tasks: Plot two stellar properties against each other, coloured by a third
Keep only the homogeneously analysed subset, within set limits
Plot a companion property against a host or companion property

features.name: Scatter plot with marginal histograms on shared axes
features.general: A scatter plot with histograms of x below it and y beside it, sharing the plot's ranges, so zooming or panning the scatter also moves the histograms
features.specific: Bokeh figure with x-histogram underneath and y-histogram on the right. Box zoom on the scatter re-ranges the x-histogram; Reset restores both
steps: Submit a plot
Read the marginal distributions
Box-zoom a region of the scatter
See the histogram follow the new range
Press Reset
serves_tasks: Plot two stellar properties against each other, coloured by a third
Pick out and identify single points

features.name: Interactive plot toolbar: select, inspect, zoom, export
features.general: Pick out a group of points with a box or lasso, hover a point to see its values and name, zoom or pan, reset the view, and save the figure as an image
features.specific: Bokeh toolbar: Pan, Lasso Select, Box Zoom, Box Select, Wheel Zoom, Reset, Save (PNG, asks for a file name), Hover (tooltip shows x, y and Star), Crosshair
steps: Choose Box Select or Lasso Select and drag over points
Hover a point to read its star name and values
Choose Box Zoom and drag to zoom
Press Reset
Press Save to download a PNG
serves_tasks: Pick out and identify single points
Plot a companion property against a host or companion property

features.name: Whole-catalogue export in several formats
features.general: Download the whole curated table in the file format your analysis tools read
features.specific: TSV / CSV / HDF buttons on the homepage, serving sweet-cat.tsv, sweet-cat.csv and sweet-cat.hdf (also reachable at /download/sweet-cat.<ext>); missing values are written as NULL
steps: Choose a format button on the homepage
Get the file and load it locally
serves_tasks: Download the whole catalogue in a chosen format

features.name: Local-analysis bundle: companion database plus merge script
features.general: Fetch the companion database and a ready-made script so you can join the two datasets yourself and reproduce the site's combined view offline
features.specific: /local/ page with buttons for SWEET-Cat.csv, exoplanetEU.csv, requirements.txt and sweetcat.py (readSC, readExo, absolute_magnitude)
steps: Open /local/
Download exoplanetEU.csv
Open or save sweetcat.py to merge it with the SWEET-Cat table
serves_tasks: Get the companion database and a script to merge them locally

features.name: Per-object record page: host parameters and its companions
features.general: One page per catalogue object listing its measured properties with uncertainties, followed by one block per linked companion with that companion's own properties; objects with no linked companions show the host values only
features.specific: /star/<name>/ page (linked from star names in the table): RA, Dec, V magnitude, parallax, Teff, logg, [Fe/H], vt and mass with ± errors, then a block per exoplanet.eu planet with mass, radius, period, semi-major axis and Teq
steps: Click a star name in the table, or open /star/<name>/
Read the stellar parameters and their uncertainties
Scroll through the planet blocks
serves_tasks: Read one object's measured parameters and its companions
